{
  "name": "unframe",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "private": true,
  "description": "A thoughtful, personal museum companion",
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "test:aws": "node --test tests/aws-*.test.js",
    "worker": "node worker/start.js",
    "load:jobs": "node scripts/load-recognition-jobs.mjs",
    "dev": "node --watch server/index.js",
    "start": "node scripts/ai-up.mjs --web",
    "server": "node server/index.js",
    "ai:index": "node scripts/index-artworks.mjs",
    "ai:train:met": "node scripts/ai-met.mjs train",
    "ai:train:met:expanded": "node scripts/ai-met.mjs expanded",
    "ai:train:met:tune": "node scripts/ai-met.mjs tune",
    "ai:met:catalogue": "node scripts/ai-met.mjs catalogue",
    "ai:met:evaluate": "node scripts/ai-met.mjs evaluate",
    "ai:met:export:openclip": "node scripts/ai-met.mjs export",
    "ai:met:query": "node scripts/ai-met.mjs query",
    "ai:met:compare": "node scripts/ai-met.mjs compare",
    "ai:met:fullframe": "node scripts/ai-met.mjs fullframe",
    "test:met": "node scripts/ai-met.mjs test",
    "ai:setup": "node scripts/ai-setup.mjs",
    "ai:setup:vision": "node scripts/ai-setup-vision.mjs",
    "ai:clip": "node scripts/ai-clip.mjs",
    "ai:up": "node scripts/ai-up.mjs",
    "ai:web": "node scripts/ai-up.mjs --web",
    "ai:acceptance": "node scripts/ai-up.mjs --web --verify",
    "ai:doctor": "node scripts/check-ai.mjs",
    "ai:validate": "node scripts/validate-local-ai.mjs",
    "ai:validate:vision": "node scripts/validate-artwork-vision.mjs",
    "ai:validate:capture": "node scripts/validate-auto-capture.mjs",
    "ai:check": "node scripts/check-ai.mjs",
    "test:ai": "node --test tests/ai.test.js tests/ai-runtime.test.js tests/artwork-analysis.test.js tests/artwork-acceptance.test.js",
    "mobile": "npm --prefix mobile start",
    "mobile:web": "npm --prefix mobile run web --",
    "mobile:check": "npm --prefix mobile run check",
    "mobile:test": "npm --prefix mobile test",
    "mobile:export": "npm --prefix mobile run export",
    "mobile:export:web": "npm --prefix mobile run export:web",
    "brand:assets": "node scripts/build-brand-assets.mjs",
    "test:mobile:e2e": "playwright test --config playwright.mobile.config.js",
    "test:mobile:web-dev": "playwright test --config playwright.mobile-dev.config.js",
    "test": "node --test tests/domain.test.js tests/api.test.js tests/ai.test.js tests/ai-runtime.test.js",
    "test:e2e": "npm run test:mobile:e2e",
    "check": "node --check server/index.js && node --check server/domain.js"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=22"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@playwright/test": "^1.63.0"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@aws-sdk/client-bedrock-runtime": "^3.1157.0",
    "@aws-sdk/client-dynamodb": "^3.1157.0",
    "@aws-sdk/client-s3": "^3.1157.0",
    "@aws-sdk/client-s3vectors": "^3.1157.0",
    "@aws-sdk/client-sqs": "^3.1157.0",
    "@aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb": "^3.1157.0",
    "@aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner": "^3.1157.0",
    "ajv": "^8.20.0",
    "sharp": "^0.35.5"
  }
}
